title: Grateful Dead Live at San Antonio Civic Auditorium on 1972-11-26
lineage: This is a restored version of SHNID 9248 combined with SHNID 123022 to produce the full show

ai_review.summary: Restored soundboard captures a fiery 1972 Texas show with smoking Dark Star > Me & Bobby McGee, Playin', Bird Song and tight band energy.
ai_review.review: The restored sound‑board source is generally clear and listenable, though a few listeners note occasional muffled sections and noise‑reduction artifacts. Musically the concert shines – Jerry ramps up the first set, Keith opens a jazzy second set, and the band delivers standout performances of Dark Star/Me & Bobby McGee, Playin', Bird Song, Box of Rain, Around And Around and Big River, keeping the energy high throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star ratings praising both performance and the dramatic restoration; only one gives a lower score due to sound issues, yielding an overall strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Restoration dramatically improves fidelity; generally crisp but some listeners note noise‑reduction artifacts and occasional muffled passages before 'Jack Straw'. Still fully listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds momentum with Jerry gaining steam; second set opens with a jazzy Keith‑led 'Playin'', flows through extended jams (Bird Song, Dark Star) and tight rockers, ending on a high note.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Pulled into maelstroms and vortexes, picks up steam toward the end of the first set and delivers strong, soaring guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Provides a walking bass line that drives 'Casey Jones', offers a tasteful solo in Dark Star; listeners are advised to boost his bass for full impact.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir tears into 'Around And Around' and gives an impassioned vocal on 'Box of Rain'.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's jazzy playing opens the second set, adding vibrant, melodic keys throughout the show.
